revelations.name: Blizzard
revelations.summary: Create a vast damaging storm that obscures sight and leaves ice.

revelations.name: Fluid Nature
revelations.summary: Resist combat maneuvers and critical confirmations and gain Dodge.

revelations.name: Fluid Travel
revelations.summary: Walk safely across liquids and later swim and breathe underwater.

revelations.name: Freezing Spells
revelations.summary: Cold spells that overcome saves also slow their targets.

revelations.name: Ice Armor
revelations.summary: Conjure scaling armor and piercing resistance from ice.

revelations.name: Icy Skin
revelations.summary: Gain scaling cold resistance and eventual immunity.

revelations.name: Punitive Transformation
revelations.summary: Temporarily transform an opponent into a harmless animal.

revelations.name: Water Form
revelations.summary: Assume increasingly powerful water elemental forms.

revelations.name: Water Sight
revelations.summary: See through mist and later scry through calm water.

revelations.name: Wintry Touch
revelations.summary: Deal cold damage by touch and later empower held weapons.

mysteries.finalRevelation: Become a master of cold and water, applying Enlarge, Extend, Silent, or Still Spell to any cold or water spell without increasing its level or casting time.

revelations.name: Air Barrier
revelations.summary: Create scaling armor that eventually deflects ranged attacks.

revelations.name: Gaseous Form
revelations.summary: Become gaseous and carry passengers at additional duration cost.

revelations.name: Invisibility
revelations.summary: Become invisible and later use greater invisibility.

revelations.name: Lightning Breath
revelations.summary: Breathe a scaling line of electricity.

revelations.name: Spark Skin
revelations.summary: Gain scaling electricity resistance and eventual immunity.

revelations.name: Thunderburst
revelations.summary: Create a widening blast that damages and deafens creatures.

revelations.name: Touch of Electricity
revelations.summary: Deal electricity damage by touch and later empower held weapons.

revelations.name: Vortex Spells
revelations.summary: Critical spell attacks stagger their targets.

revelations.name: Wind Sight
revelations.summary: Ignore wind and distance penalties and perceive through connected air.

revelations.name: Wings of Air
revelations.summary: Manifest scaling magical flight with improving maneuverability.

mysteries.finalRevelation: Become a master of air and electricity, applying Enlarge, Extend, Silent, or Still Spell to any air or electricity spell without increasing its level or casting time.
